name: Proxy decks
description: Proxy decks people share on r/mpcproxies, Ko-fi and Discord – real Magic cards with new art and frames – from their Google Drive, and proxy folders or zips on your PC. Import a deck, tick cards with a click (big tick boxes, drag or Shift+click for many), filter by type or full art, and add them to your order – printed as they are with the maker's credit – or to your deck to edit, in the deck's own frame (made with Frame studio from the maker's templates). See which cards of your deck came from which proxy deck.
author: MEZTKING
